threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the Overground is a novelty rather than a way to avoid the Tube strikes. Local wise, you’re still learning the bus routes.
Sat at the back of the 133 last night, overheard a couple arguing about a missing chicken tikka wrap. London at 2 AM is just surreal sometimes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the local kebab shop started offering vegan döner and the owner knows your order by heart. That's when I felt at home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a spontaneous techno party under a bridge on a Tuesday night, complete with a buffet of homemade cake.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to pack a snack for the BART delays—food trucks don't wait for equipment failures, and that taco craving won't just disappear.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 19 on Powell, and the driver suddenly stopped for a pigeon just strutting across the tracks—only in SF do we halt for feathered friends.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every bar serves ‘tapas’ when most locals just order ‘cerveses’ and snacks, and that's it. No fancy menus needed.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still call it 'Las Ramblas' with the definite article; true locals just say 'Rambles' like it’s part of the air we breathe.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look puzzled when you’re handed a ticket machine instead of change at the bus stop—locals barely flinch.
Caught a late-night N37 last week; a bloke was arguing with his reflection in the window, swearing it was his ex. Classic Brixton antics.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh falafel wafting through the streets when the market opens, and the chatter of neighbors making plans. That's when it hit me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can find a spontaneous street concert at any random corner in Kreuzberg, with locals and tourists alike dancing like no one’s watching.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they roll their eyes at the tourist snapping pics of a burrito outside La Taqueria instead of enjoying it inside.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading Muni riders with a ukulele while waiting for the J line at Civic Center. Totally overlooked of the chaos happening around us.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just order a 'café' and expect coffee. Here, it’s either 'café solo' or 'café con leche'—no middle ground.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the maps they hold, still studying the metro lines while the locals just hop on without a second thought.
